notes: United Nations specialized agency for ICT, three sectors: ITU-T (Standardization), ITU-R (Radiocommunication), ITU-D (Development). ITU-T Recommendations are FREE TO DOWNLOAD from itu.int — but ITU retains copyright and explicit permission is required for redistribution / republication (see https://www.itu.int/en/Pages/copyright.aspx). Same posture as AICPA TSC: access is free, redistribution is not granted by default. Notable security recommendations: X.805 (security architecture), X.1051 (info security management for telecom orgs — basis for ISO/IEC 27011), X.509 (certificate format), X.1500-series (cybersecurity exchange formats). ITU-D also coordinates the multi-stakeholder Guide to Developing a National Cybersecurity Strategy and the Global Cybersecurity Index (GCI).
